title: NAFEMS 5R: 40-element beam random displacement
source: NAFEMS, Selected Benchmarks for Forced Vibration, R0016, 1989, Test 5R; beam idealization uses the 40 beam elements of harmonic-nafems-5h with a 1 N/m line load.

quantities.reason: 1% predeclared public-reference target; the beam model is expected to reproduce the published NAFEMS beam value.
0.2% allowance for public frequency rounding, damped peak and finite frequency sampling.
